assertions.subject: Transitional cell carcinoma
assertions.quote: Transitional cell carcinoma can occur anywhere in the genitourinary tract

assertions.subject: Transitional cell carcinoma
assertions.quote: Transurethral resection of the tumor and periodic cystoscopies are the standard recommended therapy

assertions.subject: invasive bladder cancers
assertions.quote: Invasive bladder cancers may require a cystectomy

assertions.subject: carcinoma-in-situ of the bladder
assertions.quote: high-grade carcinoma-in-situ of the bladder will require intravesical Bacillus Calmette-Guerin (BCG) vaccine therapy

assertions.subject: metastatic cancers
assertions.quote: Metastatic cancers will require staging and further individualized oncological treatment

assertions.subject: metastatic cancers
assertions.quote: Metastatic cancers will require staging and further individualized oncological treatment, including radiotherapy or surgical management

assertions.subject: Genitourinary trauma
assertions.quote: Genitourinary trauma will require specific therapy depending on the hemodynamic stability of the patient and the severity and location of the injury

assertions.subject: renal injuries
assertions.quote: Most renal injuries can be managed conservatively if the patient is hemodynamically stable

assertions.subject: ureteral trauma
assertions.quote: Ureteral trauma is uncommon and will often heal with stenting

assertions.subject: intraperitoneal bladder ruptures
assertions.quote: Intraperitoneal bladder ruptures typically need immediate surgery

assertions.subject: extraperitoneal leakages
assertions.quote: extraperitoneal leakages will often heal with catheter drainage alone

assertions.subject: urethral injuries
assertions.quote: Urethral injuries may need to be surgically repaired

assertions.subject: Postprocedural hematuria
assertions.quote: Postprocedural hematuria can usually be managed conservatively or with a Foley catheter and irrigation as appropriate
